review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.notes: Checked isolation, production-module execution, explicit live-write target, independent RN/Web assertions, failure cases and evidence boundaries. User requested these three priorities. No real-session writes, signing, release or installation.

cases.description: Reject a changed/new test without a reviewed design; accept a mapped implementation
